name: icesi-emprende
description: Emprende ICESI v2 — Next.js (apps/web) + NestJS (apps/api) + PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npx --prefix apps/api tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
